title.zh: 将北民答那峨大区伊利甘市塔姆巴坎描笼涯横跨伊利甘河的塔姆巴坎桥重新命名为Mariano Lluch Badelles Sr.桥的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Tambacan Bridge Traversing the Iligan River Located in Barangay Tambacan, City of Iligan in the Northern Mindanao Region, as the Mariano Lluch Badelles Sr. Bridge

text.en: The Tambacan Bridge traversing the Iligan River located in Barangay Tambacan, City of Iligan in the Northern Mindanao region, is hereby renamed as the Mariano Lluch Badelles Sr. Bridge.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
